lines.quote: Designed and implemented an adaptive beamforming module (MVDR, LCMV) for Nordkom's coastal radar, including null steering to suppress clutter returns from fixed structures.

Wrote a matched-filter bank for Nordkom's waveform library on a TI TMS320C6678 DSP, using the chip's EDMA engine for zero-copy sample transfer and hand-tuned intrinsics for the complex multiply-accumulate.

Performed RF characterisation of the 64-element receive array: element-level gain/phase measurements using a Rohde & Schwarz ZVA network analyser, far-field pattern measurements in the company's compact antenna test range.
Implemented an extended Kalman filter for target bearing estimation in the multi-target tracking stage of the radar processing chain.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: Thesis and cover letter describe interest in and study of ground-based and spaceborne radar concepts, but no work on an instrument that itself flew on a satellite or aircraft is described.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience

lines.quote: I have had the chance to coordinate small groups of engineers working across the processing chain.

requirements.note: No named project or duration is given for this coordination, and the candidate states she wants to do technical leadership 'formally' in her next role, suggesting the described coordination was not a formal leadership arrangement; conservative claim_only chosen per refuse-to-guess.

lines.quote: Maintain a small open-source MATLAB/Octave toolkit for direction-of-arrival estimation (MUSIC, ESPRIT, root-MUSIC) on GitHub. Around 120 stars; used in at least three university courses based on citations I have found.
Regarding Oulu: my partner is from Kempele, and we have been planning a move north for over a year.
